full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 1, the Govt. and defendant No. 3, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Chuadanga filed a joint written statement. Defendant Nos. 8-32 also filed a separate written statement. The defence case, briefly, was that the suit land which belonged to the company had been taken over by the Govt. in the year 1951 in pursuance of the provisions of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The Government had subsequently leased out the land to defendant Nos. 8-32 on yearly basis and they are in possession thereof.
